create function cdn.DostepnyRejestr( @Rejestr varchar(5), @CentrumID int ) returns int as begin declare @rzr int declare @parid int declare @id int
select @rzr = isnull(frs_rejestryzrodzica,0), @parid = isnull(frs_gronumer,0) from cdn.frmstruktura where frs_id = @centrumid if @rzr = 0 if exists( select kar_seria from cdn.rejestry join cdn.frmobiekty on fro_gidtyp=kar_gidtyp and fro_gidnumer=kar_gidnumer where kar_seria=@rejestr and fro_frmid=@CentrumID) return 1 else return 0
if @parid = 0 if exists( select kar_seria from cdn.rejestry where kar_seria=@Rejestr ) return 1 else return 0
while @parid <> 0 begin select @id = @parid, @rzr = isnull(frs_rejestryzrodzica,0), @parid = isnull(frs_gronumer,0) from cdn.frmstruktura where frs_id = @parid if @parid = 0 and exists( select kar_seria from cdn.rejestry where kar_seria=@Rejestr ) return 1 if @rzr = 0 if exists( select kar_seria from cdn.rejestry join cdn.frmobiekty on fro_gidtyp=kar_gidtyp and fro_gidnumer=kar_gidnumer where kar_seria=@rejestr and fro_frmid=@id) return 1 else return 0 end return 0 end
